text:
mike (CS): FYI customer `acme-prod` hit 403 on /v1/rerank only. embeddings and generation work fine. Seen after svcacct rotation ~12:30 UTC. CS-8791 created.

elena (Eng): Can you paste a failing curl and any response body? Also which key they used?

mike (CS): curl snippet from customer: 
```
curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGci...' \
  -d '{"query":"...","documents":[...]} ' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank
```
Response: `403 {"error":"insufficient_scope","message":"missing:rerank"}`

ian (Infra): That error text is our authz path. Sounds like token claim doesn't include `rerank`. Can you dump token claims (we can ask them to curl /v1/debug/token or paste jwt decode)?

mike (CS): Asked customer to send decoded claims. They pasted: 
```
{
  "sub": "svc-acme-123",
  "scopes": ["embeddings","generation"],
  "iat": 1690000000
}
```

elena (Eng): Yup — `rerank` missing. Two likely causes: 1) provisioner CSV mapping dropped rerank for svc-acct during rotation, or 2) scope list normalization in the auth service removed it (delimiter/whitespace bug).

ian (Infra): I remember recent change in the provisioner that trims scopes and collapses duplicates. If a scope was quoted or had non-breaking space it could be lost. I'll grep rotation logs for svc-acme-123.

mike (CS): Customer says rotation was via SSO auto-provisioner at 12:28 UTC. They still have old key but rotated to new one and then hit 403. Workaround request: can we issue a temp key with rerank perms?

elena (Eng): We can issue a manual scoped key for them now. @ian can you re-run provisioner with `--force-include=rerank` for tenant acme-prod or I'll generate the key.

ian (Infra): Re-run queued. Also found provisioner log: `scopes_csv="generation, embeddings, \u00A0rerank"` — looks like NBSP present, splitting dropped rerank. Opening internal issue.

support-bot: Ticket CS-8791 updated: escalated to infra + eng. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-8791 :thumbsup:

mike (CS): Customer accepted temp key. I created API key with scopes [generation, embeddings, rerank] and gave them key id `temp-acme-8791`. They are unblocked.

elena (Eng): Thanks. Next steps: 1) infra will patch CSV parsing to normalize unicode spaces, 2) rotate back using new provisioner, 3) run a quick audit for other tenants that rotated in the last 24h. I'll own the audit and follow-up with postmortem.

ian (Infra): Patch PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/provisioner/pull/452 — normalizes whitespace and adds tests for NBSP/nb. I'll run re-provision for acme-prod after CI.

mike (CS): Noted — customer to keep temp key until we confirm reprovision. Will update CS ticket. :white_check_mark:

elena (Eng): Assigning follow-up to infra + eng. Thanks for fast triage.

mike (CS): Closing thread for now, will post final status when reprovision completes.
